newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Isreal's Gamma in JV with Sri Lanka's Tri Star.
newsitem.headline: Isreal's Gamma in JV with Sri Lanka's Tri Star.

text.p: Israel's Gamma Club will increase its garments purchases from Sri Lanka's Tri Star Apparel Exports to $32 million a year from a current $5 million under a new joint venture, the local firm said on Wednesday.
A new factory being set up under the joint venture will eventually employ up to 2,200 people, Tri Star, one of the island's biggest garments exporter, said in a statement.
